methodology_notes: TradRadar says its figures are delayed by 15 minutes.
Its long/short ratio is based on accounts, not notional position size.
Liquidation data is a lower bound because exchanges disclose only part of real-time liquidations.
Kodexius documents seven contracts across Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid and HTX.
This scope is not identical to TradRadar's seven-exchange aggregation.
The provider reports aggregate daily net flow of -496K USD while displayed rounded fund rows sum to -497K USD; retain the 1K rounding/reconciliation difference.
October 30 is the latest U.S. trading day in the capture.
Net assets, cumulative net inflows and daily creations/redemptions are different measures.

open_interest.rule: Do not average. Reconcile contract identifiers, venue inclusion, coin-margined versus stablecoin-margined contracts, and open-interest conversion units.

observations: TradRadar reports 78% long accounts and +0.0071% eight-hour funding.
limits: Account share is not notional exposure; funding is positive but not extreme by itself; no synchronized spot depth or liquidation map is included.
